title: About the college
paragraphs: The College of Science and Technology (CST) is one of the constituent colleges of the Royal University of Bhutan, located at Rinchending, Phuentsholing. Established as the Royal Bhutan Polytechnic in 1974, it was upgraded to the Royal Bhutan Institute of Technology in 2002 and renamed CST in 2006.
CST aspires to be a Centre of Excellence in Science and Technology enriched with GNH Values, offering internationally recognized programmes, generating knowledge, and serving the community.

Currently, CST offers 10 undergraduate and 3 postgraduate programmes in engineering, technology, architecture, and related fields, with plans to introduce a PhD in Engineering. The College also provides professional training, consultancy, and research services.

CST supports research and innovation through CDRR&CDS and CRSED, focusing on disaster risk reduction, community development, renewable energy, and sustainable technologies. Innovation and entrepreneurship are further promoted through FabLab CST, CST-Tech Incubation Centre, and STAR-C, Bhutan’s national hub for solar energy training, testing, innovation, and capacity building.
